faq.question: Q1. What is the IGU Field Investigator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Indira Gandhi University, Meerpur, Rewari to hire 1 Field Investigator for an HSRF-sponsored research project in the Department of Economics.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Field Investigator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Economics, Agricultural Economics, Commerce, Management, Statistics, Geography, Sociology or any other relevant Social Science discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or remuneration for the Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a remuneration of Rs 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form from igu.ac.in and send the filled form with documents via email to [email protected] as well as submit a hard copy to the Department of Economics, IGU, Meerpur, Rewari.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary and project-based.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview take place?
faq.answer: Only eligible and shortlisted candidates will be informed separately regarding the interview.
